purpose: Machine-readable external semantic corroboration for selected team-match promotion candidates. Presence here does not expose or canonically promote a field.

statsperform_event_definitions.use: Primary event-definition support for pass/cross/duel concepts.

premierleague_stats_clarification.use: Official public labels and historical availability for Premier League statistics.

statsperform_duel_article.use: Supporting explanation that Opta treats aerial and ground contests within the duel concept.

aerialWon.note: Public Premier League terminology uses aerial battles won; Opta describes aerial duels as a duel type. Exact source-field aggregation still requires FRL evidence review.

aerialLost.note: Public Premier League terminology uses aerial battles lost; exact source-field aggregation still requires FRL evidence review.

duelWon.note: Official Premier League public statistics expose duels won/lost; Opta documentation describes aerial and ground duel concepts.

duelLost.note: Official Premier League public statistics expose duels won/lost.

headClearance.note: Official Premier League public statistics explicitly list headed clearances.

backwardPass.note: Official Premier League public statistics explicitly list backward passes; Opta defines the underlying pass event family.

openPlayPass.note: Opta event definitions explicitly identify open-play passes as a pass categorisation.

fwdPass.note: The pass family and directional qualifiers are consistent with Opta semantics, but the exact aggregate source-field definition should still be confirmed.

totalCrossNocorner.note: Opta defines crosses as a distinct event concept. The no-corner qualifier is strongly suggested by the source key but needs direct source-definition confirmation.

effectiveHeadClearance.note: Headed clearances are an official public concept; the meaning of the effective qualifier needs source-definition confirmation.

longPassOwnToOpp.proposed_label: Long passes from own half to opposition half
longPassOwnToOpp.note: Opta defines pass events and qualifiers, but this exact aggregate requires direct source-definition confirmation.

longPassOwnToOppSuccess.proposed_label: Successful long passes from own half to opposition half
longPassOwnToOppSuccess.note: Proposed interpretation is source-name based and should be supported by the empirical child<=parent invariant before promotion.

totalContest.note: Contest semantics are not sufficiently established by the external sources used here. Keep fail-closed pending direct source-definition evidence.

wonContest.note: The exact source-field meaning of contest requires direct definition evidence; empirical won<=total consistency is supporting evidence only.
